<?php

// The client supplies three projected Symfony readers and its own checkpoint sink.
$offset = 0;
$missingDescriptions = $articlesByImage = [];
$audited = 0;
do {
    $page = $tools->call('cms_list_articles', ['offset' => $offset, 'limit' => 12, 'fields' => ['id']]);
    if (isset($page->error)) {
        return ['status' => 'unavailable', 'reason' => $page->error];
    }
    $articles = $tools->call('cms_get_articles', ['ids' => array_column($page->items, 'id'), 'fields' => ['id', 'meta_description', 'image_id']]);
    if (isset($articles->error)) {
        return ['status' => 'unavailable', 'reason' => $articles->error];
    }
    foreach ($articles->items as $article) {
        ++$audited;
        if ('' === trim($article->meta_description)) {
            $missingDescriptions[] = $article->id;
        }
        $articlesByImage[$article->image_id][] = $article->id;
    }
    $offset = $page->next_offset;
} while (null !== $offset);

$descriptions = ['audited' => $audited, 'missingDescriptionArticleIds' => $missingDescriptions];
$tools->call('editor_checkpoint', $descriptions);

$images = [];
foreach (array_chunk(array_keys($articlesByImage), 12) as $ids) {
    $media = $tools->call('cms_get_media', ['ids' => $ids, 'fields' => ['id', 'alt']]);
    if (isset($media->error)) {
        return ['status' => 'partial', 'descriptions' => $descriptions, 'media' => ['status' => 'unavailable', 'reason' => $media->error]];
    }
    foreach ($media->items as $image) {
        if ('' === trim($image->alt)) {
            $images[] = ['image_id' => $image->id, 'article_ids' => $articlesByImage[$image->id]];
        }
    }
}

return ['status' => 'complete', 'descriptions' => $descriptions, 'media' => ['checked' => count($articlesByImage), 'missingAlt' => $images]];
scope: Two real executions of the same maintainer-written PHP fixture, each against a fresh authenticated Symfony HTTP app. Each client guest has no network, mounts or credentials. editor_checkpoint is local delivery to the editor, outside MCP. The operator controls the grant. No live model, writes or edits to the affected articles.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Symfony article and media audit tools. Search the approved catalog by tool name, description or input schema. Returns complete input/output contracts for up to eight tools, with explicit truncation. An empty query browses the catalog. Use exact names and arguments from these results in execute_tools. Search never grants application permissions.

tools.name: execute_tools
tools.description: Execute one or more independent catalog calls using contracts returned by search_tools sequentially. Arguments are literal JSON values; no code, expressions or references between results. Returns results in input order. Stops on the first error; earlier calls are not rolled back. At most 20 calls per batch, 20 batch attempts and 20 underlying calls per session, including failures. The host owns identity and limits.
